title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility — Medicaid Copayment Bands on Oxygen Crossovers
content:
**Band table.** The Medicaid copayment withheld from an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility crossover on a Home Oxygen Therapy line follows the Medicare cost share on the line that Medicaid is asked to pay — the patient responsibility the primary left on that line.

| Medicaid record | Cost share on the line | Copayment withheld |
|---|---|---|
| QMB record | any | none |
| not QMB | no more than 10.00 | 0.65 |
| not QMB | above 10.00, no more than 45.00 | 1.30 |
| not QMB | above 45.00, no more than 75.00 | 1.90 |
| not QMB | above 75.00 | the class's per-line Medicaid copay (3.00 for Medicaid Fee-for-Service) |

## Band edges (hypothetical cost shares, record not QMB)

| Cost share | Copayment |
|---|---|
| 10.00 | 0.65 |
| 10.01 | 1.30 |
| 45.00 | 1.30 |
| 45.01 | 1.90 |
| 75.00 | 1.90 |
| 75.01 | 3.00 |

A QMB record owes no copayment at any cost share.
